name: Crazy Creek Hot Pools Resort
note: Hot-pools resort at 6162 Trans-Canada Hwy, Malakwa, in the Eagle River valley between Sicamous and Revelstoke: 97 RV and tent sites among cabins - 22 forest full-hookup (about 35 ft, up to 50A, full service year-round), 23 premium full-hookup (about 50 ft, 30A), 14 XL pull-throughs (about 60 ft), 16 budget 30A/15A power-and-water sites (about 25 ft) and 22 unserviced small-RV/tent sites; sani-dump, playgrounds, bike track, dog park; three hot pools and a cold plunge (separate admission). Online engine: 15A power-and-water standard site C$39 a night before taxes and fees (trailers to 26 ft, motorhomes to 32 ft). Booked online (WebRez - its search sits behind a human check, so a normal browser is needed). Open 365 days; water May long weekend to Thanksgiving except the forest sites. An active CP rail line runs along the property's south side. --Claude
